install.iosTitle: Add Qubo to your Home Screen
install.iosDescription: It opens full screen, like an app, straight on your site.
install.iosStep1: Tap Share in the Safari toolbar.
install.iosStep2: Choose “Add to Home Screen”. Scroll the list if you don't see it.
install.iosStep3: Tap Add. Qubo is now on your Home Screen.
